senses: Ἀράμ indec. (Heb. רָם), Aram: [[r:MAT.1.3|Mat 1:3-4]], [[r:LUK.3.33|Luk 3:33]] (R, txt., WH, Ἀρνεί).† (AS)

G0630.strongs: to free fully, i.e. (literally) relieve, release, dismiss (reflexively, depart), or (figuratively) let die, pardon or (specially) divorce
G0630.kjv: (let) depart, dismiss, divorce, forgive, let go, loose, put (send) away, release, set at liberty
senses: ἀπο-λύω
to set free, release: [[r:LUK.13.12|Luk 13:12]], [[r:JHN.19.10|Jhn 19:10]], al.; a debtor, [[r:MAT.18.27|Mat 18:27]]; metaphorically, of forgive­ness, [[r:LUK.6.37|Luk 6:37.]]

to let go, dismiss (Field, Notes, 9 f.): [[r:MAT.15.23|Mat 15:23]], [[r:LUK.2.29|Luk 2:29 9:12]], [[r:ACT.19.41|Act 19:41]], al.; of divorce, τ. γυναῖκα: [[r:MAT.1.19|Mat 1:19 5:31-32 19:3, 8 19:10]] [[r:MRK.10.2|Mrk 10:2, 4 10:11]], [[r:LUK.16.18|Luk 16:18]]; with ref. to Gk. and Rom. (net Jewish) custom, τ. ἄνδρα: [[r:MRK.10.12|Mrk 10:12.]] Mid., to depart: [[r:ACT.28.25|Act 28:25]] (MM, see word) (AS)

G0622.strongs: to destroy fully (reflexively, to perish, or lose), literally or figuratively
senses: ἀπ-όλλυμι and ἀπολλύω
Act.,
to destroy utterly, destroy, kill: Mk 124, 922, al.; τ. ψνχήν, [[r:MAT.10.28|Mat 10:28]], al.;
to lose utterly: [[r:MAT.10.42|Mat 10:42]], al.; metaphorically, of failing to save, [[r:JHN.6.39|Jhn 6:39 18:9]].
Mid.,
to perish;

of persons: [[r:MAT.8.26|Mat 8:26]], al. Metaphorical, of loss of eternal life, [[r:JHN.3.15|Jhn 3:15-16 10:28 17:12]], [[r:ROM.2.12|Rom 2:12]], [[r:1CO.8.11|1Co 8:11 15:18]], [[r:2PE.3.9|2Pe 3:9]]. In οἱ ἀπολλὺμενοι, the perishing, contrasted in [[r:1CO.1.18|1Co 1:18]], al., with οἱ σωζόμενοι, the "perfective" force of the verb, WH. " implies the completion of the process of destruction," is illustrated (see M, Pr., 114 f.; M, Th., ii, 2:10);

to be lost: [[r:LUK.15.4|Luk 15:4 21:18]]. Metaphorical, on the basis of the relation between shepherd and flock, of spiritual destitution and alienation from God: [[r:MAT.10.6|Mat 10:6 15:24]], [[r:LUK.19.10|Luk 19:10]] (MM, see word; DCG, i, 191 f., ii, 76, 554; Cremer, 451) (AS)

G0649.strongs: set apart, i.e. (by implication) to send out (properly, on a mission) literally or figuratively
G0649.kjv: put in, send (away, forth, out), set (at liberty)
senses: ἀπο-στέλλω, prop., to send away, to dispatch on service;
to send with a commission, or on service;
of persons: Christ, [[r:MAT.10.40|Mat 10:40]]; the apostles, 10:16; servants, [[r:MRK.12.2|Mrk 12:2]]; angels, 13:27;

of things: ὄνος, [[r:MAT.21.3|Mat 21:3]]; τὸ δρέπανον, [[r:MRK.4.29|Mrk 4:29]]; τ. λόγον, [[r:ACT.10.36|Act 10:36]]; τ. ἐπαγγελίαν (i.e. the promised Holy Spirit), [[r:LUK.24.49|Luk 24:49]], Rec.; before εἰς, [[r:MAT.20.2|Mat 20:2]], [[r:LUK.11.49|Luk 11:49]], [[r:JHN.3.17|Jhn 3:17]]; ὀπίσω, [[r:LUK.19.14|Luk 19:14]]; ἔμπροσθεν, [[r:JHN.3.28|Jhn 3:28]]; πρὸ προσώπου, [[r:MAT.11.10|Mat 11:10]]; πρός, [[r:MAT.21.34|Mat 21:34]]; with ref. to sender or place of departure: ἀπό, [[r:LUK.1.26|Luk 1:26]] (Rec. ὑπό); παρά, [[r:JHN.1.6|Jhn 1:6]]; ἐκ, [[r:JHN.1.19|ib 1:19]]; ὑπό, [[r:ACT.10.17|Act 10:17]] (Rec. ἀπό); before inf., [[r:MRK.3.14|Mrk 3:14]], al.; ἵνα, [[r:MRK.12.2|Mrk 12:2]], al.; εἰς (of purpose), [[r:HEB.1.14|Heb 1:14]]; without direct obj.: before πρός, [[r:JHN.5.33|Jhn 5:33]]; λέγων, [[r:JHN.11.3|Jhn 11:3]]; ἀποστείλας, with indic., [[r:MAT.2.16|Mat 2:16]], [[r:ACT.7.14|Act 7:14]], [[r:REV.1.1|Rev 1:1]].

to send away, dismiss: [[r:LUK.4.18|Luk 4:18]], [[r:MRK.5.10|Mrk 5:10 8:26 12:3]] (cf. ἐξ-, συν-αποστέλλω). SYN.: πέμπω, the general term. ἀ. "suggests official or authoritative sending" (see Thayer, see word πέμπω; Westc., Jo., 298; Epp. Jo., 125; Cremer, 529; MM, see word). (AS)

G0611.strongs: to conclude for oneself, i.e. (by implication) to respond; by Hebraism (compare) to begin to speak (where an address is expected)
senses: in cl.,
to separate, distinguish.

to choose. Mid., to answer: [[r:MAT.27.12|Mat 27:12]], [[r:MRK.14.61|Mrk 14:61]], [[r:LUK.3.16|Luk 3:16 23:9]], [[r:JHN.5.17|Jhn 5:17, 19]] [[r:ACT.3.12|Act 3:12]]. In late Gk. the pass, also is used in this sense, and pass. forms are the more frequently in NT (M, Pr., 39, 161; MM, see word);

in general sense: absol., [[r:MRK.12.34|Mrk 12:34]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.22.46|Mat 22:46]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:MAT.12.38|Mat 12:38]]; before πρός, [[r:ACT.25.16|Act 25:16]];
Hebraistically
like ענה, to begin to speak, take up the conversation (Kennedy, Sources, 124f.): [[r:MAT.11.25|Mat 11:25]], al.,
(ii)

redundant, as in the Heb. phrase וַיַּעַן וַיּאֹמֶר (Dalman, Words, 24f., 38; M, Pr., 14; Bl., §58, 4; 74, 2; Cremer, 374): ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπε, [[r:MAT.4.4|Mat 4:4]]; ἔφη, 8:8; λέγει, [[r:MRK.3.33|Mrk 3:33]]; in Jo most frequently (ἀπεκ. κ. εἶπε, 1:49.) (AS)

G0647.root: neuter of a (presumed) adjective from a derivative of [[w:G0868]]
senses: (ἀφίστημι),
in cl., only in phrase ἀποστασίου δίκη, an action against a freedman for forsaking his προστάτης (Dem.).

In LXX, βιβλίον ἀποστασίου, a bill of divorce: [[r:MAT.19.7|Mat 19:7]], [[r:MRK.10.4|Mrk 10:4]]; in same sense ἀ. alone (MM, see word), [[r:MAT.5.31|Mat 5:31]] (for other late exx., see MM, l.with; Kennedy, Sources, 121).† (AS)

G0654.strongs: to turn away or back (literally or figuratively)
senses: ἀπο-στρέφω trans., with accusative,
to turn away, remove: [[r:ROM.11.26|Rom 11:26]], [[r:2TI.4.4|2Ti 4:4]]; metaphorically, to turn away from allegiance, pervert: [[r:LUK.23.14|Luk 23:14]];

to turn back, return: μάχαιραν, [[r:MAT.26.52|Mat 26:52.]] Pass., reflex., to turn oneself away from: with accusative, [[r:MAT.5.42|Mat 5:42]], [[r:2TI.1.15|2Ti 1:15]], [[r:TIT.1.14|Tit 1:14]], [[r:HEB.12.25|Heb 12:25]]; so act., absol., [[r:ACT.3.26|Act 3:26]] (cf. [[r:SIR.8.5|Sir 8:5]]; Bl., § 53, 1; Cremer, 880).† (AS)

G0684.strongs: ruin or loss (physical, spiritual or eternal)
G0684.kjv: damnable(-nation), destruction, die, perdition, X perish, pernicious ways, waste
senses: (ἀπόλλυμι), destruction, waste, loss, perishing (in π., of money, see MM, see word): [[r:MAT.26.8|Mat 26:8]], [[r:MRK.14.4|Mrk 14:4]], [[r:ACT.8.20|Act 8:20]], [[r:ROM.9.22|Rom 9:22]], [[r:1TI.6.9|1Ti 6:9]], [[r:2PE.2.1|2Pe 2:1]]; in special sense of the loss of eternal life, perdition, the antithesis of σωτηρία: [[r:MAT.7.13|Mat 7:13]], [[r:JHN.17.12|Jhn 17:12]], [[r:PHP.1.28|Php 1:28 3:19]], [[r:2TH.2.3|2Th 2:3]], [[r:HEB.10.39|Heb 10:39]], [[r:2PE.2.3|2Pe 2:3 3:7 3:16]], [[r:REV.17.8|Rev 17:8, 11]] (DB, iii, 744).† (AS)

G0686.root: probably from [[w:G0142]] (through the idea of drawing a conclusion)
G0686.strongs: a particle denoting an inference more or less decisive (as follows)
G0686.kjv: haply, (what) manner (of man), no doubt, perhaps, so be, then, therefore, truly, wherefore
senses: illative particle, expressing a more subjective or informal inference than οὖν, then: prop. (as in cl.), the second word in the sentence, [[r:ROM.7.21|Rom 7:21 8:1]], [[r:GAL.3.7|Gal 3:7]]; ἐπεὶ ἄρα, [[r:1CO.7.14|1Co 7:14]] (with another word between) 5:10; as the first word, [[r:LUK.11.48|Luk 11:48]], [[r:ACT.11.18|Act 11:18]], [[r:ROM.10.17|Rom 10:17]], [[r:1CO.15.18|1Co 15:18]], [[r:2CO.5.15|2Co 5:15 7:12]], [[r:HEB.4.9|Heb 4:9]]; so prop. in apodosis after protasis with εἰ, [[r:MAT.12.28|Mat 12:28]], [[r:LUK.11.20|Luk 11:20]], [[r:GAL.2.21|Gal 2:21 3:29 5:11]], [[r:HEB.12.8|Heb 12:8]] (κενὸν ἄρα), [[r:1CO.15.14|1Co 15:14]]; often in interrogations, direct and indirect, τίς (τί) ἄρα, [[r:MAT.18.1|Mat 18:1 19:25, 27 24:45]], [[r:MRK.4.41|Mrk 4:41]], [[r:LUK.1.66|Luk 1:66 8:25 12:42 22:23]], [[r:ACT.12.18|Act 12:18]]; εἰ ἄρα, [[r:MRK.11.13|Mrk 11:13]], [[r:ACT.8.22|Act 8:22]]; εἴπερ ἄρα, [[r:1CO.15.15|1Co 15:15]]; οὐκ ἄρα, [[r:ACT.21.38|Act 21:38]]; μήτι ἄρα, [[r:2CO.1.17|2Co 1:17]]; in strengthened forms, ἄρα γε, ἄραγε, [[r:MAT.7.20|Mat 7:20 17:26]], [[r:ACT.17.27|Act 17:27]], and more frequently ἄρα οὖν (Epp. Paul.), so then, [[r:ROM.5.18|Rom 5:18 7:3, 25 8:12 9:16, 18 14:19]], [[r:GAL.6.10|Gal 6:10]], [[r:EPH.2.19|Eph 2:19]], [[r:1TH.5.6|1Th 5:6]], [[r:2TH.2.15|2Th 2:15]] (Bl., §77, 2; 78, 5; MM, see word).† (AS)
ἀπο-χωρέω, -ῶ to go away, depart, withdraw: before ἀπό, [[r:MAT.7.23|Mat 7:23]], [[r:LUK.9.39|Luk 9:39]], [[r:ACT.13.13|Act 13:13]] (absol., [[r:LUK.20.20|Luk 20:20]], Tr., mg.).† (AS)

G0680.strongs: properly, to attach oneself to, i.e. to touch (in many implied relations)
senses: to touch, hold, handle; (act.) to start a fire; "to touch a woman" means "to get married" primarily to bring in contact, fit, fasten; to light, kindle, [[r:MRK.4.21|Mk 4:21]]; [[r:LUK.8.16|Lk 8:16]]; to touch, [[r:MAT.8.3|Mt 8:3]]; to meddle, venture to partake, [[r:COL.2.21|Col 2:21]]; to have intercourse with, to know carnally, [[r:1CO.7.1|1Cor 7:1]]; by implication to harm, [[r:1JN.5.18|1Jn 5:18]]

G0652.strongs: a delegate; specially, an ambassador of the Gospel; officially a commissioner of Christ ("apostle") (with miraculous powers)
G0652.kjv: apostle, messenger, he that is sent
senses: (ἀοστέλλω),
a fleet, an expedition (Dem.).
a messenger, one sent on a mission (Hdt., LXX, l.with, and π.; see M, Pr., 37 f.; MM, see word; M, Th., i, 2:7 and reff.): [[r:JHN.13.16|Jhn 13:16]], [[r:2CO.8.23|2Co 8:23]] [[r:PHP.2.25|Php 2:25]].
In NT, an Apostle of Christ

with special ref. to the Twelve: [[r:MAT.10.2|Mat 10:2]], [[r:MRK.3.14|Mrk 3:14]], [[r:LUK.11.49|Luk 11:49]], [[r:EPH.3.5|Eph 3:5]], [[r:REV.18.20|Rev 18:20]], al., equality with whom is claimed by St. Paul, [[r:GAL.1.1|Gal 1:1, 11]] ff, [[r:1TI.2.7|1Ti 2:7]], a1.;

in a wider sense of prominent Christian teachers, as Barnabas, [[r:ACT.14.14|Act 14:14]], apparently also Silvanus and Timothy, [[r:1TH.2.6|1Th 2:6]], and perhaps Andronicus and Junias (Junia?), [[r:ROM.16.7|Rom 16:7]] (see ICC, in l); of false teachers, claiming apostleship: [[r:2CO.11.5|2Co 11:5 11:13]], [[r:REV.2.2|Rev 2:2]]. (On the different uses of the term in NT, see Lit., Gal., 92-101; Cremer, 530; DB, i, 126; DCG, i, 105; Enc. Br., ii, 196 ff.) (AS)

G0696.strongs: silver (the metal, in the articles or coin)
senses: (ἀργός, shining), silver (on its relation to ἀργύριον, see MM, see word): [[r:MAT.10.9|Mat 10:9]], [[r:ACT.17.29|Act 17:29]], [[r:JAS.5.5|Jas 5:5]], [[r:REV.18.12|Rev 18:12]].† (AS)

G0601.strongs: to take off the cover, i.e. disclose
senses: ἀπο-καλύπτω
in general sense (cl.), to reveal, uncover, disclose,
of persons: pass., Christ, [[r:LUK.17.30|Luk 17:30]]; Antichrist, [[r:2TH.2.3|2Th 2:3 2:6 2:8]]

G0615.strongs: to kill outright; figuratively, to destroy
senses: ἀπο-κτείνω (also in late forms -κτέννω, [[r:MAT.10.28|Mat 10:28]], a1., LTTr., -κτεννύω, [[r:MRK.12.5|Mrk 12:5]], WH), to kill: [[r:MAT.14.5|Mat 14:5]], al.; before instr. ἐν (which see), [[r:EPH.2.16|Eph 2:16]], [[r:REV.2.23|Rev 2:23]], al. Metaphorical: [[r:ROM.7.11|Rom 7:11]]; τ. ἔχθραν, [[r:EPH.2.16|Eph 2:16]]; τὸ γράμμα ἀποκτείνει [[r:2CO.3.6|2Co 3:6]] (on the perfective force of this verb, see M, Pr., 114) (AS)

G0600.strongs: to reconstitute (in health, home or organization)
senses: ἀπο-καθ-ίστημι (ἀποκαθιστάω, [[r:MRK.9.12|Mrk 9:12]], Rec., -ιστάνω, LTTr.; cf. [[r:ACT.1.6|Act 1:6]]; -κατιστάνω, WH),

to restore, i.e. to a former condition: of health, [[r:MAT.12.13|Mat 12:13]], [[r:MRK.3.5|Mrk 3:5 8:25]], [[r:LUK.6.10|Luk 6:10]]; of social or political affairs, [[r:MAT.17.11|Mat 17:11]], [[r:MRK.9.12|Mrk 9:12]], [[r:ACT.1.6|Act 1:6]].
to give back, bring back: [[r:HEB.13.19|Heb 13:19]] (so in π., MM, see word; cf. also Cremer, 312).† (AS)

G0692.strongs: inactive, i.e. unemployed; (by implication) lazy, useless
senses: (in late Gk., incl. NT, -ή, -όν; ἀ- neg., ἔργον) inactive, idle: [[r:MAT.20.3|Mat 20:3]], 6, [[r:1TI.5.13|1Ti 5:13]], [[r:TIT.1.12|Tit 1:12]], [[r:2PE.1.8|2Pe 1:8]]. Metaphorical, of things, inactive, ineffective, worthless: ῥῆμα, [[r:MAT.12.36|Mat 12:36]]; πίστις, [[r:JAS.2.20|Jas 2:20]] (see Cremer, 259 f.).† SYN.: βραδύς, slow; νωθρός, sluggish (Tr., Syn., § civ) (AS)

G0659.kjv: cast off, lay apart (aside, down), put away (off)
senses: ἀπο-τίθημι to put off or aside; in NT always mid.,

to put of from oneself as a garment: τ. ἱμάτια, [[r:ACT.7.58|Act 7:58]]; metaphorically, in ethical sense, to put of, lay aside: [[r:ROM.13.12|Rom 13:12]], [[r:EPH.4.22|Eph 4:22, 25]], [[r:COL.3.8|Col 3:8]], [[r:HEB.12.1|Heb 12:1]], [[r:JAS.1.21|Jas 1:21]], [[r:1PE.2.1|1Pe 2:1]];
to stow away, put: ἐν τ. φυλακῇ (MM, see word), [[r:MAT.14.3|Mat 14:3.]]† (AS)
ἀπο-κεφαλίζω (ἀπό, κεφαλή), to behead: [[r:MAT.14.10|Mat 14:10]], [[r:MRK.6.16|Mrk 6:16, 28]] [[r:LUK.9.9|Luk 9:9]].† (AS)

G0694.root: neuter of a presumed derivative of [[w:G0696]]
G0694.strongs: silvery, i.e. (by implication) cash; specially, a silverling (i.e. drachma or shekel)
senses: (ἄργυρος), prop., a piece of silver (Lft., Notes, 191); in NT,

money: [[r:MAT.25.18|Mat 25:18, 27]], [[r:MRK.14.11|Mrk 14:11]], [[r:LUK.9.3|Luk 9:3 19:15, 23 22:5]], [[r:ACT.8.20|Act 8:20]]; (with) a silver coin: p1., [[r:MAT.26.15|Mat 26:15 27:3-6, 9 28:12, 15]], where the value is that of a shekel or tetradrachm; ἀργυρίου μυριάδες πέντε (prob. drachmas; MM, see word), [[r:ACT.19.19|Act 19:19.]]† (AS)

G0645.strongs: to drag forth, i.e. (literally) unsheathe (a sword), or relatively (with a degree of force implied) retire (personally or factiously)
senses: ἀπο-σπάω, -ῶ to draw off or away, tear away (MM, see word): [[r:ACT.20.30|Act 20:30]]; μάχαιραν, draw a sword, [[r:MAT.26.51|Mat 26:51]]; pass., to be parted or withdrawn (Field, Notes, 134; but see Thayer, see word), [[r:LUK.22.41|Luk 22:41]], [[r:ACT.21.1|Act 21:1]].† (AS)

G0633.strongs: to wash off (reflexively, one's own hands symbolically)
senses: ἀπο-νίπτω to wash off: mid. (reflex.), τ. χεῖρας, [[r:MAT.27.24|Mat 27:24.]]† (AS)
ἀπο-κυλίω (see: κυλίω), to roll away: [[r:MAT.28.2|Mat 28:2]], [[r:MRK.16.3|Mrk 16:3]], [[r:LUK.24.2|Luk 24:2]].† (AS)
ἀπο-στεγάζω (στέγη), to unroof: [[r:MRK.2.4|Mrk 2:4.]]† (AS)
(ἀποκρύπτω), hidden: [[r:MRK.4.22|Mrk 4:22]], [[r:LUK.8.17|Luk 8:17]], [[r:COL.2.3|Col 2:3]] (see Lft., in l; MM, see word).† (AS)

G0639.root: from a compound of [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and the base of [[w:G4198]]
G0639.strongs: to have no way out, i.e. be at a loss (mentally)
senses: (ἄπορος, ἀ- neg., πόρος, a way, resource), to be at a loss, be perplexed: absol., [[r:MRK.6.20|Mrk 6:20]] (ἐποίει, R, mg.); mid., be in doubt: absol., [[r:2CO.4.8|2Co 4:8]]; with accusative, [[r:ACT.25.20|Act 25:20]]; before περί, [[r:LUK.24.4|Luk 24:4]]; ἐν, [[r:GAL.4.20|Gal 4:20]]; περὶ τίνος λέγει, [[r:JHN.13.22|Jhn 13:22.]]† SYN.: διαπορέω, διακρίνομαι, διστάζω, μετεωρίζομαι (see DCG, i, 491) (AS)

G0657.strongs: literally, to say adieu (by departing or dismissing); figuratively, to renounce
G0657.kjv: bid farewell, forsake, take leave, send away
senses: ἀπο-τάσσω to set apart. Mid., in late Gk. (El., § 37, 1; Swete, Mk., 136 f.; MM, e. dative,
to forsake: [[r:LUK.14.33|Luk 14:33.]]† (AS)

G0618.strongs: to receive (specially, in full, or as a host); also to take aside
senses: ἀπο-λαμβάνω

to receive from another; absol., to receive as one's due: [[r:LUK.16.25|Luk 16:25 18:30]] (seel. λάβῃ) [[r:LUK.23.41|Luk 23:41]], [[r:ROM.1.27|Rom 1:27]], [[r:GAL.4.5|Gal 4:5]], [[r:COL.3.24|Col 3:24]], 2Jn 8.
to receive back: [[r:LUK.6.34|Luk 6:34 15:27]].
to take apart or aside: [[r:MRK.7.33|Mrk 7:33]] (cf. use in π. of the recluses of the Serapeum; MM, see word).† (AS)

G0609.strongs: to amputate; reflexively (by irony) to mutilate (the privy parts)
senses: ἀπο-κόπτω to cut off: [[r:MRK.9.43|Mrk 9:43, 45]], [[r:JHN.18.10|Jhn 18:10, 26]] [[r:ACT.27.32|Act 27:32]]. Mid., to mutilate oneself, have oneself mutilated: [[r:GAL.5.12|Gal 5:12]] (cf. [[r:DEU.23.1|Deu 23:1]] LXX; and see Cremer, 751; MM, see word).† (AS)

G0650.kjv: defraud, destitute, kept back by fraud
senses: ἀπο-στερέω, -ῶ (στερέω, to rob), to defraud, deprive of, despoil (in cl. chiefly of the misappropriation of trust funds, Field, Notes, 33; cf. MM, see word): absol., [[r:MRK.10.19|Mrk 10:19]], [[r:1CO.6.8|1Co 6:8]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:1CO.7.5|1Co 7:5.]] Mid., endure deprivation: [[r:1CO.6.7|1Co 6:7]] (WM, § 38, 3; but see Bl., § 54, 5; M, Pr., 162); pass., ἀπεστερημένοι, bereft of: [[r:1TI.6.5|1Ti 6:5.]]† (AS)

G0687.root: a form of [[w:G0686]], denoting an interrogation to which a negative answer is presumed
senses: interrog. particle, implying anxiety or impatience, "quite rare and only in Luke and Paul, therefore a literary word" (Bl., §77, 2).
(num igitur) expecting a neg. reply, [[r:LUK.18.8|Luk 18:8]]; ἆρά γε, [[r:ACT.8.30|Act 8:30.]]
(ergone) in apodosis, expecting an affirm. reply, [[r:GAL.2.17|Gal 2:17]] (Bl., l.with; Lft., Ga., in l.; MM, see word). † (AS)

G0635.strongs: to lead astray (figuratively); passively, to stray (from truth)
senses: ἀπο-πλανάω, -ῶ to cause to go astray; metaphorically, of leading into error: [[r:MRK.13.22|Mrk 13:22]]; pass., to be led astray: [[r:1TI.6.10|1Ti 6:10.]]† (AS)

ἀπο-φέρω to carry off, bear, or lead away: with accusative, [[r:MRK.15.1|Mrk 15:1]], [[r:1CO.16.3|1Co 16:3]], [[r:REV.17.3|Rev 17:3 21:10]]. Pass., [[r:LUK.16.22|Luk 16:22]], [[r:ACT.19.12|Act 19:12]].† (AS)

G0602.kjv: appearing, coming, lighten, manifestation, be revealed, revelation
senses: ἀπο-κάλυψις, -εως, ἡ (ἀποκαλύπτω), an uncovering, laying bare (Plut.). Metaphorical, a reveal­ing, revelation: a disclosure of divine truth, or a manifestion from God: [[r:LUK.2.32|Luk 2:32]] [[r:ROM.2.5|Rom 2:5 8:19 16:25]], [[r:1CO.1.7|1Co 1:7 14:6 14:26]], [[r:2CO.12.1|2Co 12:1 12:7]], [[r:GAL.1.12|Gal 1:12 2:2]], [[r:EPH.1.17|Eph 1:17 3:3]] [[r:2TH.1.7|2Th 1:7]] [[r:1PE.1.7|1Pe 1:7 1:13 4:13]], [[r:REV.1.1|Rev 1:1]].† SYN.: ἐπιφάνεια, παρουσία, φανέρωσις (see Tr., Syn., xciv; Lft., Notes, 102, 178; Westc, Eph., 178 f.; M, Th., 145 ff.; Cremer, 343) (AS)
ἀπό-κρισις, -εως, ἡ (ἀποκρίνομαι), an answering, an answer: [[r:LUK.2.47|Luk 2:47 20:26]], [[r:JHN.1.22|Jhn 1:22 19:9]].† (AS)
ἀπο-πνίγω to choke: [[r:MAT.13.7|Mat 13:7]], [[r:LUK.8.7|Luk 8:7]]; pass., of drowning (= καταποντίζομαι), [[r:LUK.8.33|Luk 8:33.]]† (AS)

G0681.strongs: properly, to fasten to, i.e. (specially) to set on fire
senses: ἅπτω prop., to fasten to; hence, of fire, to kindle, light: [[r:LUK.8.16|Luk 8:16 11:33 15:8]], [[r:ACT.28.2|Act 28:2]]. Mid., with genitive, to fasten oneself to, cling to, lay hold of (so in π.; MM, see word): [[r:MAT.8.3|Mat 8:3, 15]], [[r:JHN.20.17|Jhn 20:17]], al.; of carnal intercourse, [[r:1CO.7.1|1Co 7:1]]; with reference to levitical and ceremonial prohibitions, [[r:2CO.6.17|2Co 6:17]], [[r:COL.2.21|Col 2:21]]; of hostile action, [[r:1JN.5.18|1Jn 5:18]] (cf. ἀν-, καθ-, περι- άπτω) SYN.: θιγγάνω, ψηλαφάω. ἅ. is the stronger, θ., to touch, the lighter term. ψ. is to feel, as in search of something (Tr., Syn., § xvii; Lft., Col., 201 f.) (AS)
ἀπο-τινάσσω to shake of: [[r:LUK.9.5|Luk 9:5]], [[r:ACT.28.5|Act 28:5]].† (AS)

G0631.root: middle voice from [[w:G0575]] and μάσσω (to squeeze, knead, smear)
senses: απο-μάσσω (μάσσω, Att... -ττω, to touch, handle), to wipe off, wire clean: mid., [[r:LUK.10.11|Luk 10:11.]]† (AS)

G0613.strongs: to conceal away (i.e. fully); figuratively, to keep secret
senses: ἀπο-κρύπτω to hide, conceal, keep secret: with accusative, [[r:LUK.10.21|Luk 10:21]]; pass., [[r:1CO.2.7|1Co 2:7]], [[r:EPH.3.9|Eph 3:9]], [[r:COL.1.26|Col 1:26]] (MM, see word).† (AS)

G0653.strongs: to speak off-hand (properly, dictate), i.e. to catechize (in an invidious manner)
senses: (στόμα),
In cl., to speak from memory, to dic­tate to a pupil (Plat.).
In late Gk., to catechize, question: [[r:LUK.11.53|Luk 11:53]] (MM, see word).† (AS)

G0626.root: middle voice from a compound of [[w:G0575]] and [[w:G3056]]
G0626.strongs: to give an account (legal plea) of oneself, i.e. exculpate (self)
G0626.kjv: answer (for self), make defence, excuse (self), speak for self
senses: (ἀπό, λόγος),
to defend: with accusative, [[r:ROM.2.15|Rom 2:15.]]

to defend one's self: absol., [[r:LUK.21.14|Luk 21:14]], [[r:ACT.26.1|Act 26:1]]; before ὅτι, [[r:ACT.25.8|Act 25:8]]; τί, to adduce something in one's defence, [[r:LUK.12.11|Luk 12:11]], [[r:ACT.26.24|Act 26:24]] (ταῦτα) [[r:ACT.24.10|Act 24:10]] (τὰ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ); περί, with genitive of thing(s), and ἐπί, with genitive of person(s), [[r:ACT.26.2|Act 26:2]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.19.33|Act 19:33]], [[r:2CO.12.19|2Co 12:19]].† (AS)
ἀπο-κλείω to shut fast: [[r:LUK.13.25|Luk 13:25.]]† (AS)
ἀπο-τελέω, -ῶ to bring to an end, complete, accomplish (cf. MM, see word): [[r:LUK.13.32|Luk 13:32]], [[r:JAS.1.15|Jas 1:15]].† (AS)
ἀπο-λείχω (for ἐπιλ-, which see), to lick up: [[r:LUK.16.21|Luk 16:21]], Rec.† (AS)

G0606.strongs: to be reserved; figuratively, to await
senses: ἀπό-κειμαι to be laid up, in store, laid away: [[r:LUK.19.20|Luk 19:20.]] Metaphorical, C. dative of person(s), to be reserved (Dem., Plat.; and see MM, see word): [[r:COL.1.5|Col 1:5]], [[r:2TI.4.8|2Ti 4:8]], [[r:HEB.9.27|Heb 9:27]].† (AS)
(ἀπορέω), perplexity: [[r:LUK.21.25|Luk 21:25]] (MM, see word; on the construction, see Field, Notes, 74 f.).† (AS)
ἀπο-ψύχω
to breathe out life, expire (Thue.; LXX, l.with).
to leave off breathing, faint (Hom., Od., xxiv, 348): before ἀπό, [[r:LUK.21.26|Luk 21:26.]]† (AS)

G0629.strongs: (the act) ransom in full, i.e. (figuratively) riddance, or (specially) Christian salvation
senses: ἀπο-λύτρωσις, -εως, ἡ (ἀπολυτρόω, to release on payment of ransom, cf. λύτρον), release effected by pay­ment of ransom, redemption, deliverance; metaphorically, [[r:HEB.11.35|Heb 11:35]]; of deliverance thr. Christ from evil and the consequences of sin: [[r:LUK.21.28|Luk 21:28]], [[r:ROM.3.24|Rom 3:24]] (Vau., in l) 8:23, [[r:1CO.1.30|1Co 1:30]], [[r:EPH.1.7|Eph 1:7, 14 4:30]], [[r:COL.1.14|Col 1:14]], [[r:HEB.9.15|Heb 9:15]]. (On the extent to WH. the word retains the sense of ransom, see ICC, [[r:ROM.3.24|Rom 3:24]], Westc., He., 297 ff.; see also ICC, Eph., 11; DCG, ii, 605; Cremer, 410; Deiss., LAE, 331; Lft., Notes, 271, 316; Tr., Syn., § 77.)† (AS)
(συναγωγή), expelled from the congregation (Field, Notes, 96), excommunicated: [[r:JHN.9.22|Jhn 9:22 12:42 16:2]] (Cremer, 64, 607).† (AS)
ἀπο-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀποστέλλω),
In cl., a sending away (MM, see word), as, an expedition (Hdt.).
In LXX
discharge, dis­missal ([[r:ECC.8.8|Ecc 8:8]]);
In NT, the office of an Apostle of Christ, apostleship: [[r:ACT.1.25|Act 1:25]], [[r:ROM.1.5|Rom 1:5]], [[r:1CO.9.2|1Co 9:2]], [[r:GAL.2.8|Gal 2:8]] (Cremer, 530).† (AS)
ἀπο-φθέγγομαι to speak forth, give utterance: [[r:ACT.2.4|Act 2:4, 14 26:25]] (MM, s. see).† (AS)

G0690.strongs: an Arab or native of Arabia
senses: an Arabian: [[r:ACT.2.11|Act 2:11.]]† (AS)
ἀπο-κατά-στασις, -εως, ἡ (ἀποκαθίστημι), restoration: [[r:ACT.3.21|Act 3:21]] (in τ. of repairs and restorations of temples, see MM, see word).† (AS)

G0683.root: from [[w:G0575]] and the middle voice of ὠθέω or ὤθω (to shove)
G0683.strongs: to push off, figuratively, to reject
G0683.kjv: cast away, put away (from), thrust away (from)
senses: ἀπ-ωθέω, -ῶ to thrust away. Mid., to thrust away from oneself, refuse, reject: with accusative of person(s) (MM, see word), [[r:ACT.7.27|Act 7:27, 39 13:46]], [[r:ROM.11.1|Rom 11:1-2]], [[r:1TI.1.19|1Ti 1:19]].† (AS)
ἀπο-πίπτω to fall off: [[r:ACT.9.18|Act 9:18.]]† (AS)
ἀπο-πλέω, -ῶ to sail away: [[r:ACT.13.4|Act 13:4 14:26 20:15 27:1]] (Burton, 159).† (AS)

G0673.strongs: to rend apart; reflexively, to separate
senses: ἀπο-χωρίζω to separate, part asunder: pass., [[r:REV.6.14|Rev 6:14]]; reflexively, to separate oneself: [[r:ACT.15.39|Act 15:39.]]† (AS)

G0624.root: from the pagan deity Ἀπόλλων (i.e. the sun
G0624.strongs: from); Apollonia, a place in Macedonia
senses: Apollonia, a city of Macedonia: [[r:ACT.17.1|Act 17:1.]]† (AS)

G0697.root: from Ἄρης (the name of the Greek deity of war) and a derivative of [[w:G4078]]
G0697.strongs: rock of Ares, a place in Athens
senses: Ἄρειος Πάυος (T, Ἄριος Π.), -ου, ὁ Hill of Pres or Mars, Areopagus; also, the Court of Areopagus, the highest tribunal of Athens: [[r:ACT.17.19|Act 17:19, 22]].† (AS)

G0698.strongs: an Areopagite or member of the court held on Mars' Hill
senses: a judge of the Court of Areopagus: [[r:ACT.17.34|Act 17:34.]]† (AS)
(ἄργυρος, κόπτω, to beat) a silversmith: [[r:ACT.19.24|Act 19:24]] (Plut.; 77., see MM, see word).† (AS)

G0670.root: from [[w:G0575]] and the middle voice of [[w:G5412]]
senses: ἀπο-φορτίζομαι (φορτίζω, to load), to discharge a cargo (Field, Notes, 134), to unlade: with accusative, τ. γόμον, [[r:ACT.21.3|Act 21:3.]]† (AS)

ἀπο-σκευάζω to pack and carry off; mid., to pack and remove one's goods: [[r:ACT.21.15|Act 21:15]], Rec. (see ἐπισ-).† ἐπι-σκευάζω, to equip, make ready; mid., to make one's preparations: [[r:ACT.21.15|Act 21:15.]]† (AS)

άποστασία, -ας, ἡ (ἀφίστημι), defection, apostasy, revolt; in late Gk. (MM, Exp., viii; Lft., Notes, 111; Cremer, 308) for cl. ἀπόστασις, frequently in sense of political revolt, in LXX (e.g. [[r:JOS.22.22|Jos 22:22]], [[r:2CH.29.19|2Ch 29:19]], [[r:JER.2.19|Jer 2:19]]) and NT always of religious apostasy: [[r:ACT.21.21|Act 21:21]], [[r:2TH.2.3|2Th 2:3]].† (AS)

G0627.kjv: answer (for self), clearing of self, defence
senses: (ἀπολογέομαι), a speech in defence: [[r:ACT.25.16|Act 25:16]], [[r:2CO.7.11|2Co 7:11]], [[r:PHP.1.7|Php 1:7, 16]], [[r:2TI.4.16|2Ti 4:16]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:1CO.9.3|1Co 9:3]], [[r:1PE.3.15|1Pe 3:15]]; before πρός, [[r:ACT.22.1|Act 22:1.]]† (AS)

G0628.strongs: to wash fully, i.e. (figuratively) have remitted (reflexively)
senses: ἀπο-λούω to wash off, wash away; mid., metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), to wash off oneself: ἀμαρτίας, [[r:ACT.22.16|Act 22:16]]; absol., ἀπελούσασθε, ye washed yourselves clean (cf. Cremer, 406), [[r:1CO.6.11|1Co 6:11.]]† (AS)

G0677.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [[w:G4350]]
G0677.strongs: actively, inoffensive, i.e. not leading into sin; passively, faultless, i.e. not led into sin
senses: (προσκόπτω),
act., not causing to stumble: metaphorically, of not leading others into sin, [[r:1CO.10.32|1Co 10:32.]]
Pass., not stumbling, without offence, blameless: [[r:ACT.24.16|Act 24:16]], [[r:PHP.1.10|Php 1:10]] (for exx., see MM, see word).† (AS)
ἀπο-ρίπτω (Rec. -ρρίπτω, c1.), to throw away, cast forth: reflexively, [[r:ACT.27.43|Act 27:43]] (BV, cast themselves overboard; see MM, see word).† (AS)

G0675.strongs: (in the genitive, i.e. possessive case) of Appius, the name of a Roman
senses: Ἀππιος, -ου, ὁ Appius; Ἀππίου Φόρον, Appii Forum (Market of Appius), a town in Italy: [[r:ACT.28.15|Act 28:15.]]† (AS)

G0685.strongs: properly, prayer (as lifted to Heaven), i.e. (by implication) imprecation
senses: a prayer (MM, see word).
(as in Homer) a curse, malediction: [[r:ROM.3.14|Rom 3:14]] (LXX),† (AS)

G0603.root: from a comparative of [[w:G0575]] and a compound of κάρα (the head) and [[w:G1380]] (in the sense of watching)
senses: ἀπο-καραδοκία, -ας, ἡ (ἀποκαραδοκέω, used by Aq. in [[r:PSA.37.7|Psa 37:7]] for חוּל; ἀπό, κάρα the head, δοκέω, in Ion., to watch), to watch with outstretched head, watch anxiously (Polyb., π.; see Deiss., LAE, 374.5, 377 f.), [[r:ROM.8.19|Rom 8:19]], [[r:PHP.1.20|Php 1:20]] (Lft., in l; Cremer, 177).† (AS)
ἀπο-τολμάω, -ῶ to be quite bold, make a bold venture: [[r:ROM.10.20|Rom 10:20.]]† (AS)
(ἀποτέμνω, to cut of), steepness, sharpness; metaphorically, severity (MM, see word): [[r:ROM.11.22|Rom 11:22.]]† (AS)
ἀπο-στυγέω, -ῶ (στυγέω, to hate), to abhor: [[r:ROM.12.9|Rom 12:9.]]† (AS)

G0610.root: from [[w:G0611]] (in its original sense of judging)
senses: ἀπό-κριμα, -τος, τό (ἀποκρίνω);
prop., a judicial sentence: [[r:2CO.1.9|2Co 1:9]], R, mg.

an answer (see Thayer, see word): [[r:2CO.1.9|2Co 1:9]], R, txt. (In FlJ, Ant., xiv, 10, 6, of a rescript of the Senate; in Inscr. of an official decision, Deiss., BS, 257; a reply to a deputation, MM, see word: cf. also Cremer, 3'75).† (AS)

G0664.root: adverb from a derivative of a comparative of [[w:G0575]] and τέμνω (to cut)
senses: ἀποτόμως adv., abruptly, curtly, hence sharply, severely: [[r:2CO.13.10|2Co 13:10]], [[r:TIT.1.13|Tit 1:13]] (MM, see word).† (AS)
Arabia , (Herdotus Historicus), poetry Ἀρραβία, (Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus) (ML)

ἀπο-κατ-αλλάσσω (cf. καταλλάσσω: ἀπό here signifies completely, see Lft., Col., l.with; Ellic., Eph., l.with; but also Mey., Eph., l.with), to reconcile completely: [[r:EPH.2.16|Eph 2:16]], [[r:COL.1.20|Col 1:20-21]].† (AS)
(ἄπειμι);
absence (Æsch., Thuc.): [[r:PHP.2.12|Php 2:12]],
deficiency, waste (MM, s.v).† (AS)

ἀρεσκία (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ (ἀρέσκω), pleasing, desire to please: [[r:COL.1.19|Col 1:19]] In Gk. writers (Arist., Polyb.), most frequently in bad sense, but in π., Inscr., and in Philo, as above (see Deiss., BS, 224; MM, see word; Cremer, 642).† (AS)

G0671.strongs: the act of using up, i.e. consumption
senses: ἀπό-χρησις, -εως, ἡ (ἀποχράομαι, to use to the full, abuse) abuse, misuse: [[r:COL.2.22|Col 2:22]] (MM, see word).† (AS)

G0642.strongs: to bereave wholly, i.e. (figuratively) separate (from intercourse)
senses: ἀπ-ορφανίζω (ἀπό, ὀρφανός), to be bereaved (prop., of a parent, Lft., Notes, 36); metaphorically, [[r:1TH.2.17|1Th 2:17]] (where Field thinks it = χωρισθέντες, Notes, 199).† (AS)

G0676.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a comparative of [[w:G4314]] and εἶμι (to go)
senses: ἀ-πρόσ-ιτος, -ον (πρόσειμι, to go to), unapproachable: φῶς, [[r:1TI.6.16|1Ti 6:16.]]† (AS)

G0619.root: from a comparative of [[w:G0575]] and λαύω (to enjoy)
senses: (ἀπολαύω, to take of, enjoy a thing) enjoyment: [[r:1TI.6.17|1Ti 6:17]], [[r:HEB.11.26|Heb 11:26]] (for late exx., see MM, see word).† (AS)
ἀπο-τρέπω to turn away; mid., to turn oneself away from: with accusative, [[r:2TI.3.5|2Ti 3:5.]]† (AS)

G0620.strongs: to leave behind (passively, remain); by implication, to forsake
senses: ἀπο-λείπω
to leave, leave behind (in π. a term. techn. in wills; see MM, see word): [[r:2TI.4.13|2Ti 4:13 4:20]], [[r:TIT.1.5|Tit 1:5]]; pass., to be reserved, remain: [[r:HEB.4.6|Heb 4:6, 9 10:26]].
to desert, abandon: Ju 6.† (AS)
Apphia: Phm 2 (MM, see word).† (AS)
ἀπο-τίνω (or -τίω) to pay off, repay: Phm 19 (MM, see word).† (AS)

G0616.strongs: to breed forth, i.e. (by transference) to generate (figuratively)
senses: ἀπο-κυέω (Rec. -κύω), -ῶ (ἀπό, κυέω or κύω, to be pregnant), prop., "the medical word for birth as the close of pregnancy" (Hort, Ja., 26 f.). In κοιν, "an ordinary syn. of τίκτω, but definitely 'perfectivised' (M, Pr., 111 ff.; MM, see word) by the ἀπό, and so implying safe delivery," to bring forth, give birth to: [[r:JAS.1.15|Jas 1:15, 18]].† (AS)

G0644.root: from a compound of [[w:G0575]] and a derivative of [[w:G4639]]
senses: ἀπο-σκίασμα, -τος, τό (ἀποσκιάζω, to cast a shadow; v,s. σκία) a shadow: [[r:JAS.1.17|Jas 1:17]] (MM, see word).† (AS)

G0678.root: adverb from a compound of [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a presumed compound of [[w:G4383]] and [[w:G2983]] (compare [[w:G4381]])
G0678.strongs: in a way not accepting the person, i.e. impartially
senses: ἀπροσωπολήμπτως (Rec. -λήπτως, cl.), adv. (α- neg., προσωπολήμπτης), without respect of persons, impartially: [[r:1PE.1.17|1Pe 1:17.]]† (AS)
ἀπο-νέμω (νέμω, to distribute), to assign, apportion: [[r:1PE.3.7|1Pe 3:7.]] (In π. of a Prefect who renders to all their dues; see MM, see word)† (AS)
ἀπο-φεύγω to flee from, escape: with accusative, [[r:2PE.2.18|2Pe 2:18 2:20]]; with genitive, [[r:2PE.1.4|2Pe 1:4.]]† (AS)

G0691.strongs: to be idle, i.e. (figuratively) to delay
senses: (ἀργός), to be idle; τὸ κρίμα... ἀ., lingers (cf. MGr. ἀργά, late: MM, see word): [[r:2PE.2.3|2Pe 2:3.]]† (AS)

G0679.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [[w:G4417]]
senses: ἄ-πταιστος, -ον (πταίω), without stumbling, sure-footed: metaphorically (MM, see word), Ju 24.† (AS)
(present ptcp. of ἀπολλύω), Apollyon, i.e. the Destroyer: [[r:REV.9.11|Rev 9:11]] (cf. Ἀβάδδων). (Cremer, 453; DB, i, 125, 172.) † (AS)
